title: Determinants of Women Farmers’ Adaptation Strategies to Climate Variability in the Central Cotton-Growing Region of Benin
content: This paper examines the factors influencing women farmers' adaptation strategies to climate change in Benin's central cotton-growing area. Through cross-sectional data and a multivariate probit model, it finds that gender is not a significant factor in adaptation choices. Education and access to climate information promote short-cycle crop adoption, while experience and farm size relate to crop diversification and intercropping. The study highlights the need for targeted initiatives to improve access to education, climate information, financial services, and agricultural extension.
